title: Peacock with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail feathers fan -->
  <g>
    <!-- outer tail feathers -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="38" ry="22" fill="#1a6b3a" opacity="0.9"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="34" ry="19" fill="#249050" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- feather eyespots -->
    <circle cx="24" cy="34" r="5" fill="#2bcf6e"/>
    <circle cx="24" cy="34" r="3" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <circle cx="24" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#1a4fa0"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="28" r="5" fill="#2bcf6e"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="28" r="3" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <circle cx="38" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#1a4fa0"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="28" r="5" fill="#2bcf6e"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="28" r="3" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#1a4fa0"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="34" r="5" fill="#2bcf6e"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="34" r="3" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="34" r="1.5" fill="#1a4fa0"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="24" r="5" fill="#2bcf6e"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="24" r="3" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="24" r="1.5" fill="#1a4fa0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="14" ry="18" fill="#1e7fe0"/>
  <!-- Chest highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="9" ry="12" fill="#3f9af0"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="46" y="46" width="8" height="14" rx="4" fill="#1e7fe0"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="9" fill="#1e7fe0"/>
  <!-- Sparkly eyes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="46" cy="42" r="3.5" fill="#f0f8ff"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="42" r="3.5" fill="#f0f8ff"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="42" r="2" fill="#0a2a4a"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="42" r="2" fill="#0a2a4a"/>
    <!-- sparkles -->
    <circle cx="45" cy="41" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="41" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <path d="M47 39 l0.5 -1.2 l0.5 1.2 l1.2 0.5 l-1.2 0.5 l-0.5 1.2 l-0.5 -1.2 l-1.2 -0.5 z" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <path d="M55 39 l0.5 -1.2 l0.5 1.2 l1.2 0.5 l-1.2 0.5 l-0.5 1.2 l-0.5 -1.2 l-1.2 -0.5 z" fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M50 46 l-3 4 l6 0 z" fill="#f0a020"/>
  <!-- Head crest -->
  <g>
    <line x1="50" y1="35" x2="48" y2="28" stroke="#e8b820" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="27" r="1.5" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="35" x2="52" y2="27" stroke="#e8b820" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="26" r="1.5" fill="#e8b820"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="35" x2="50" y2="26" stroke="#e8b820" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="25" r="1.5" fill="#e8b820"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <path d="M46 86 l-4 6 m4 -6 l0 6 m0 -6 l4 6" stroke="#e8b820" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M54 86 l-4 6 m4 -6 l0 6 m0 -6 l4 6" stroke="#e8b820" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
